brief: A multilingual human coordination platform. The Open Circle identity makes room for another person while keeping their agency visible. Direction A selected by the user; full UI system remains under review.

concepts.name: Open Circle
concepts.idea: An open C makes room for one more person.
rationale: The aperture connects the name to openness.
A detached square remains distinct: participation is a choice.
One-color geometry survives compact app use.

recommendation: Open Circle is the selected direction. Apply the fixed signature rather than rebuilding its parts.
next_steps: Review integration in the light design system
Approve the complete visual system before frontend implementation
